# Rise — Board Exam Practice

> A free, client-only progressive web app (PWA) for CBSE and ICSE Grade 10
> board-exam preparation. No login required for core practice features.

## What Rise does

Rise helps Grade 10 students prepare for CBSE and ICSE board exams through:

- **Mock tests** — timed, full-length MCQ tests per subject (Mathematics,
  Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, English, Social Science,
  Economics, and more)
- **Short-answer practice** — board-style short and long answer questions with
  model answers
- **Textbook solved exercises** — step-by-step worked solutions to NCERT and
  other textbook exercises
- **Revision notes** — concise subject-wise notes organised by chapter
- **Leitner spaced-repetition** — questions surface again based on how well
  a student answered them
- **Daily streaks and goals** — habit-tracking to encourage consistent study
- **Arena mode** — competitive timed challenges
- **AI tutor** — in-app AI explanations for questions

## Supported boards and grades

- CBSE Grade 10
- ICSE Grade 10
- CBSE Grade 12 (partial — Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology,
  Computer Science, Economics, Political Science, Psychology)

## Technology

Static PWA served from Cloudflare Pages. No server-side code. All progress
stored in the browser (localStorage). Firebase Authentication (optional sign-in
for cross-device sync) and Firestore (family/group challenge features).

Question banks are original content created for Rise. Not for reproduction
without permission. Model answers are based on NCERT/board marking schemes.
